notes: Maker page is on Black Friday sale ($1,999); crossed-out regular $2,099 recorded. Maker: default 20 mph with throttle, adjustable 12-28 mph, 'Ebike Class 1/2/3' -> Class 2; maker also mentions a Custom Mode with Class 3 throttle speeds (not in California). Maker weight 57 lbs excludes fenders, kickstand and pedals (battery not stated); both reviews measured 63.3 lbs with battery and accessories.
